What We Do

Crafting Metal, Building Trust – Zain Fabrication

Zain Fabrication is a trusted Mangalore workshop providing quality welding and metal fabrication for residential, commercial and industrial projects since 2015.

See Our Work →

Gates & Grills

Main gates, sliding and swing gates, window and safety grills in MS and stainless steel — designed for security and style.

Railings & Staircases

Balcony, terrace and staircase railings plus spiral and straight steel staircases with a clean, durable finish.

Roofing & Sheds

Terrace roofing, car parking sheds and warehouse sheds with strong trusses and quality roofing sheets.

Structural Steel Work

Steel frames, beams, columns and mezzanine floors fabricated and erected for commercial and industrial sites.

Welding & Fabrication

Precise cutting, welding and joining of metals to create custom parts and structures to your exact measurements.

Repair & Maintenance

Repairs, reinforcement and repainting of existing gates, grills, sheds and metal structures.

Where Quality Meets Craftsmanship

Every project is personally overseen by our proprietor, Ivan Dsouza — from the first measurement to the final coat of paint.

Proven Experience

Serving Mangalore since 2015 with skilled welders and fabricators who know metalwork inside out.

Commitment to Quality

Quality materials and protective coatings built to handle coastal humidity and salt air.

Customer First

Free site visits, clear quotations and honest advice — no hidden charges.

On-Time Delivery

Clear timelines agreed upfront, with neat and safe on-site installation.

About Zain Fabrication

Your Metalwork, Our Mastery – Zain Fabrication, Your Trusted Partner.

Founded in 2015 by Ivan Dsouza, Zain Fabrication has grown from a small workshop into a trusted name for metal fabrication in Mangalore. We combine skilled welding, quality steel and practical design to deliver work that looks great and lasts for years.
